definitions.gloss: releasing fish or animals into the wild; stocking
definitions.explanation: The practice of releasing fish, fry, or other aquatic creatures into rivers, lakes, or the sea. Often done for conservation, fishing industry purposes, or as part of environmental restoration.
The controlled release of water from a dam or reservoir.

notes:
{放流|ほうりゅう} has two distinct uses: releasing fish/animals into the wild, and discharging water from dams.

FORMS:
{放|ほう} (release) + {流|りゅう} (flow)

SENSE 1 — FISH STOCKING:
- {稚魚|ちぎょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{放流|ほうりゅう}: releasing fry (young fish)
- サケ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{放流|ほうりゅう}: salmon stocking
- {放流|ほうりゅう}⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: fish-release experience (educational activity)
Commonly done for conservation and fisheries management.

SENSE 2 — WATER DISCHARGE:
- ⟦ダム→ダム：00034_damu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{放流|ほうりゅう}: dam discharge
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{放流|ほうりゅう}: emergency discharge
- {放流|ほうりゅう}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: discharge volume
Seen in weather warnings during heavy rainfall. ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{放流|ほうりゅう} alerts warn of sudden water level rises downstream.
